subject.title: 🐛 Feishu channel fails with tenant_access_token error when HTTP proxy is configured

question: Should Feishu SDK HTTP and WebSocket bootstrap traffic follow OpenClaw ambient/managed proxy routing, bypass proxy routing by default, or wait for an explicit per-channel proxy policy?
rationale: The bug blocks affected Feishu users, but the fix decides whether credentialed channel traffic follows the operator proxy boundary or goes direct in mixed-network environments.

options.title: Approve ambient/managed proxy routing
options.body: Land the linked Feishu proxy PR after refresh if maintainers want Feishu SDK HTTP to follow OpenClaw's existing ambient and managed proxy helper contract.

options.title: Require channel proxy policy first
options.body: Keep runtime behavior unchanged until Feishu has an explicit direct-versus-proxy mode with docs and upgrade expectations.

options.title: Document workaround only
options.body: Reject the runtime routing change and rely on NO_PROXY or operator environment configuration, accepting manual recovery for affected users.

recommendation.title: Approve ambient/managed proxy routing
recommendation.body: Land the linked Feishu proxy PR after refresh if maintainers want Feishu SDK HTTP to follow OpenClaw's existing ambient and managed proxy helper contract.

likelyOwner.reason: The choice turns on the shared ambient proxy helper and managed egress boundary he recently worked on.
